scope: All six use CQ22, whose complete 52-paragraph source this author read. CQ89/215 were not read by this author. Existing answers were seen; no routing code was inspected to design these questions. These become development cases once evaluated.

cases.question: Why did Cam recognize Kat as Canadian, and did that mean her NES boxes were PAL?
cases.qualification: Her French/English box text tipped him off; the hosts distinguish Canadian bilingual/Mattel packaging from automatic PAL identification. Cam says he has no boxed NES games, and Johnny's Canadian black-box subset is only a future low-priority wish.

evidence.quote: you had games that had like French and English on it
most of my black box games are French and English on them

cases.question: Which manufacturer did Johnny accidentally attach to the CD-i, and how was he corrected?
cases.qualification: He says Panasonic and is corrected to Philips, rendered Phillips in the transcript. Preserve this as an in-episode correction, not confirmation that the hosts performed a catalog audit or that all games on either criticized system are worthless.

cases.question: Does Johnny's ninety-hour Dragon Warrior VII save tell us how long he actively played?
cases.qualification: No. He gives an approximate save-file figure and explains he sometimes fell asleep with the game running during illness. It is not a completion time, benchmark, diagnosis or verified account of illness causation.

evidence.quote: my save file is at like 90 hours

cases.question: Can we tell from this episode who owned Blazing Lazers on Wii Virtual Console?
cases.qualification: The Wii ownership remark is unlabelled and should remain actor-uncertain. Cam is clearly the speaker reporting first completion on Thursday, but that does not automatically assign the separate Wii copy to him. No audio verification was performed.

evidence.quote: I finally beat it for the first time on Thursday
I have it on I have it on the Wii

cases.question: What was Johnny's workaround for Canadian import costs, and did Cam really book an expo trip?
cases.qualification: Johnny proposes saving avoided fees toward a Portland trip and wants an Instagram meetup. Cam's supposed commitment emerges in teasing banter; no booking or attendance is reported. Customs and price statements are historical host claims, not present travel/tax advice.

evidence.quote: take whatever that import fee would be and then save it
I’m trying to get everyone to Portland this year for like some kind of Instagram meetup

cases.question: What would Johnny's ideal big-screen handheld setup look like, and what limits did he acknowledge?
cases.qualification: He praises GameCube with Game Boy Player and a SNES-style Hori controller, and wishes for a Wii U DS player using its two screens. He acknowledges touch-heavy DS games would not all fit the idea, and EarthBound is an RPG-library exception. This is preference and a hypothetical accessory, not proof of an announced product, universal compatibility or legal approval.

evidence.quote: I think the GameCube with a Gameboy player creates the best Nintendo system ever created
like a Hori Super Nintendo controller for the GameCube
